Linus and Luke discuss Best Buy’s new “comparable value” pricing tactic, calling it a misleading dark pattern that inflates fake discounts and erodes trust. They vent about how terms like “compare at,” “starting at,” and “up to” are increasingly abused, and argue that big retailers normalizing this behavior will make shopping even harder unless consumers push back with better tools and awareness.
